# w3-older project

- Design decision 003 supersedes the pre-001 note "put cursor stuff in toyapp/export_cursor.py": cursor paging lives in toyapp.pagination (CursorPage, paginate_cursor), catalog has browse_next. Shared opaque v2 URL-safe base64 tokens in toyapp.tokens (decimal zero-based offset payload). Exports were also moved to pagination in decision 002.
- CRITICAL: decimal-offset resume tokens must retain the v2 base64 wrapper even for parseable numbers like "2"; decode_offset rejects bare "2" as invalid (tests parametrize this).
- Run tests with /Users/instructor/Code/odsc-workshop/.workshop-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q (workshop venv, python 3.14).
